description.message: Pustite svoje tafove da rade u vašem Chrome-u, samo na dozvoljenim sajtovima. Rizični koraci čekaju vaše odobrenje na telefonu.

pair_body.message: Na telefonu otvorite tafs, zatim Nalog › Chrome › Uparite Chrome. Ovde unesite prikazani kod.

pair_profile.message: tafs radi u svom Chrome profilu. Prijavite se tamo samo na sajtove koje želite da koristi vaš tafs.

pair_error_code.message: Taj kod nije ispravan ili je istekao. Počnite ponovo na telefonu.

pair_error_expired.message: Kod je istekao. Počnite ponovo na telefonu.

pair_error_proof.message: Uparivanje nije bilo moguće potvrditi, pa ništa nije upareno. Počnite ponovo na telefonu.

pair_error_planque.message: tafs nije bilo moguće dosegnuti. Pokušajte ponovo za trenutak.

pair_error_not_released.message: Ova verzija proširenja ne može da se upari. Instalirajte tafs iz Chrome veb-prodavnice.

pair_error_failed.message: Nešto je pošlo naopako. Pokušajte ponovo.

paired_body.message: Vaši tafovi mogu da koriste ovaj Chrome samo na sajtovima koje navodi veza. Rizične korake odobravate na telefonu.

idle.message: Sada ovde ne radi nijedan taf.

unpair_confirm.message: Prekinuti uparivanje ovog Chrome-a? Vaši tafovi neće moći da ga koriste dok ga ponovo ne uparite.

paused_failures.message: Pauzirano nakon tri uzastopna neuspela koraka.

paused_no_progress.message: Pauzirano: isti korak dvaput zaredom nije ništa promenio.

step_act_press.description: A step in the side panel's list: the taf pressed Enter, Escape or an arrow key in the page.

step_act_scroll.description: A step in the side panel's list: the taf scrolled the page.

step_act_back.description: A step in the side panel's list: the taf went back to the page before.

coach_error.message: To nije stiglo do Coach-a. Pokušajte ponovo.

unpaired.message: Ovaj Chrome više nije uparen. Ponovo ga uparite u aplikaciji tafs na telefonu.

coach_empty_body_reads.message: To je isti čet kao u aplikaciji tafs. Kada Coach radi na stranici, prvo je pročita.
coach_empty_body_reads.description: Empty chat: body. There's no Share button: Coach and tafs read a page themselves.

coach_previous_error.message: Ranije razgovore nije bilo moguće učitati.

tafs_not_read.message: Vaši tafs nisu mogli da se pročitaju. Pokušajte ponovo.

no_taf_here.message: U ovom Chrome-u još ne radi nijedan taf.

setup_taf.message: Podesite novi taf za ovaj sajt

hand_title.description: Title of the panel card where the taf asks the person to do a step themselves

hand_says.description: Label above the taf's own words on that card; it reads as the taf speaking

hand_show.description: Button on that card: brings the page to the front and outlines the field

hand_done.description: Button on that card: the person did it

hand_declined.description: Button on that card: the person won't do it now

hand_careful.message: Upisujte samo tamo gde verujete ovoj stranici.
hand_careful.description: Fixed line on that card under the taf's words

hand_show_changed.message: Stranica se promenila otkad ju je taf pročitao, pa nema na šta da se pokaže. Potražite to kako taf kaže.
hand_show_changed.description: Under the Your turn card's buttons, after Show me: the page is no longer the one the taf read.

hand_show_hidden.message: To polje ili dugme trenutno nije na ekranu. Šire okno bi moglo da ga prikaže, ili ga potražite kako taf kaže.
hand_show_hidden.description: Under the Your turn card's buttons, after Show me: the field the taf named is hidden or gone (a narrow window can hide a search box).

hand_show_unanswered.message: Stranica nije odgovorila. Potražite to kako taf kaže.
hand_show_unanswered.description: Under the Your turn card's buttons, after Show me: the page couldn't be asked to outline the field.

hand_show_no_field.message: Ovo je ta stranica. Taf nije naveo polje ni dugme na koje bi se pokazalo.
hand_show_no_field.description: Under the Your turn card's buttons, after Show me: the page came to the front; the taf's words say what to do.

step_handed.description: Step list: the taf handed the person one thing to do in the page.

step_hand_done.description: Step list: the person pressed Done on the Your turn card.

step_hand_declined.description: Step list: the person pressed Not now on the Your turn card.

at_work.description: Label before the side panel's row of tafs at work, one button each; a button brings that taf's tab to the front.

go_to_taf.description: Accessible name of a taf's button in that row.

coach_archived_body.message: Svaka poruka čuva se 30 dana od trenutka kad je napisana, arhivirana ili ne.

taf_remove_on_phone.message: Taf se uklanja na telefonu: otvorite ga u aplikaciji tafs, zatim Uklonite. Uklanjanje se tamo odobrava.
